name: Professional
styleInstructions: Formal register for senior or external readers. No contractions, no slang, no exclamation marks, no filler adverbs (really, basically). 'Hello' not 'Hey'; 'Thank you' not 'Thanks'. Measured wording, structured sentences. Preserve every fact and number exactly.

fewShot.in: hey john thanks a lot we cant make it friday its gonna be really tight
fewShot.out: Hello John, thank you very much. We cannot make it on Friday; the schedule will be tight.
